coreMemory.english: n. an opinion about what someone should do
coreMemory.structure: give advice /ɡɪv ədˈvaɪs/（给建议）；ask for advice /æsk fɔr ədˈvaɪs/（征求建议）；follow someone’s advice /fɑloʊ someone’s ədˈvaɪs/（听从某人建议）；a piece of advice /ə pis ʌv ədˈvaɪs/（一条建议）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use advice with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of advice in context；❌ translate advice word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “give advice”

commonErrors.wrong: use advice with the same article in every context
commonErrors.wrongPhonetic: /jus ədˈvaɪs wɪð ðə seɪm ɑrtəkəl ɪn ɛvɚi kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.right: check the countability of advice in context
commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ədˈvaɪs ɪn kɑntɛkst/
commonErrors.note: 同一个名词在不同义项下可能有可数、不可数或单复数差异，不能机械套用冠词。
不要只按中文逐字替换；优先把本卡高频搭配作为完整句块记忆。

coreMemory.directAntonym: bad guidance /bæd ɡaɪdəns/（与“建议”意义相反）
